I am a data scientist focused on turning complex, real-world data into reliable
analytics and decision-support tools. My work spans **Python, SQL, machine
learning, data engineering, automation, and data visualization**, with an
emphasis on building reproducible systems rather than one-off analyses.

My graduate capstone combines a production-style baseball data pipeline,
PostgreSQL warehouse, statistical analysis, and machine learning to create
actionable MLB matchup and pitch-strategy recommendations. The project includes
automated data collection, feature engineering, model evaluation, and
interactive scouting reports.
